stem: Which statement is an example of using credit?

options.label: A
options.text: Paying sales tax at a restaurant

options.label: B
options.text: Saving part of your income in a bank

options.label: C
options.text: Using cash to pay for a book

options.label: D
options.text: Getting a loan to pay for a car

difficulty_rationale: The question requires basic understanding of the concept of credit and identifying the correct example from common financial actions, which is a straightforward recall and comprehension task for grade 3.
